name: JellyCache single-plugin read test
overview: Single-plugin same-season prefetch and local cache routing test.
description: TEST ONLY. Jellyfin 12.1.0. Disabled by default; upgrades retain configuration. Automatic Ahead 2 with bounded storage. Known official 12.1 services use request, ffmpeg, subtitle and attachment lifetime protection; uncertain operations remain protected until restart. Paused-only administrator cleanup skips active readers and refuses unknown files. Full isolated Jellyfin 12.1 cleanup verified on Windows; NAS 0.4.1 acceptance remains pending. Manual reading mode remains available.

versions.changelog: v0.4.1-management-test.1. M2 safe management: paused-only cleanup of unoccupied managed cache; preserve active reads and origin fallback. See docs/M2_DELIVERY.md.

v0.4.0-lifecycle-test.1. M1 lifecycle integration: reclaim after actual reads/process completion, avoid speculative pins, handle stale exited jobs, classify copy failures. See docs/M1_DELIVERY.md and docs/PREFETCH_TEST.md.
v0.3.1-prefetch-test.1. Automatic same-season prefetch, queue/status dashboard, bounded copying and conservative playback protection. See docs/PREFETCH_TEST.md.
v0.2.0-read-test.2. Single-plugin read routing experiment. See docs/READ_PROBE_TEST.md.

name: JellyCache experimental bridge
overview: Experimental episode prefetch event bridge; separate Worker required.
description: TEST ONLY. Built against Jellyfin 12.1.0 / .NET 10. Disabled by default. Requires a separately configured JellyCache Worker and stable media entry. Real Jellyfin/fnOS loading, FUSE, Docker visibility and playback are not verified. Do not change production /video mounts.

versions.changelog: v0.1.0-test.1 experimental prerelease. No production compatibility claim. See docs/JELLYFIN_PLUGIN.md for enablement and limitations.
